summary.problem: Requests made using model 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' fail with API error 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT ('Request contains an invalid argument.').
summary.root_cause: 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' and related 3.1 models are missing from DEFAULT_MODEL_CONFIGS.aliases in packages/core/src/config/defaultModelConfigs.ts. As a result, ModelConfigService fails to resolve a specific alias and falls back to 'chat-base', which sets 'includeThoughts: true' in thinkingConfig without setting 'thinkingLevel: ThinkingLevel.HIGH' as required for Gemini 3.1 models.
summary.context: Gemini 3.x models require thinkingLevel to be specified in thinkingConfig (configured via 'chat-base-3'). Without an alias definition extending 'chat-base-3', the API request configuration generated for 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' is malformed.

steps: In packages/core/src/config/defaultModelConfigs.ts, add missing alias definitions for 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview', 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools', and 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview' under DEFAULT_MODEL_CONFIGS.aliases extending 'chat-base-3'.
Ensure modelConfig for each alias sets the corresponding model identifier string.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: ModelConfigService resolves 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' configuration with thinkingLevel set to HIGH from 'chat-base-3', ensuring valid API request generation.
verification_steps: Run vitest on packages/core/src/services/modelConfig.golden.test.ts with UPDATE_GOLDENS=true to update the golden files with the new model aliases.
Run vitest packages/core/src/services/modelConfig.golden.test.ts to verify that golden tests pass.
